title: Debris Zone
caption: Debris Zone (V)
game_text: Once per turn, ▲ Crash Landing or Weapon Malfunction. OR If you have a piloted AT-AT on Hoth, target artillery weapon at a related site is lost. {sense}
lore: A reactor core explosion in a destroyed AT-AT causes a plasma release which shatters its armor, showering the immediate area with molten projectiles.
